purpose: Phase 1 preregistered grep probes for the DSH default retrieval baseline. Each probe is derived ONLY from the task input that a user/agent legitimately holds (symbol name, declared path or pathPrefix, relation endpoint path/name) and MUST NOT be adjusted after seeing results. Scoring uses eval/m5/gold.json; this file carries no answer.

rules.declaration: pattern = request.name with ripgrep metacharacters escaped; path = request.pathPrefix when the task declares one, otherwise the whole corpus (unscoped).
rules.source: grep cannot return a range; the file is named in the task, so the probe is a file-scoped topic keyword and the baseline must additionally read the whole file. File bytes are therefore part of the source-arm cost.
rules.relation: probe pattern is the statement form implied by request.types (imports/exports/calls) or the request-endpoint name (contains); the probe cannot know the expected target names.
rules.note: No probe uses a string taken from the gold span, snippet, or expected target list.
